latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Deploy and manage Next.js sites to Netlify with approval gates.

- Supports deployments for soilrichbyjohn.com and Synergy salon.
- Adds user approval gates for deploy and rollback commands, with summary prompts.
- Integrates with Notion to log deploy activity, status, and commit details.
- Provides commands for deploy, deploy status, rollback, and fetching deploy logs.
- Requires Netlify CLI setup and permissions for git, npm, npx, and remote access.
